note: The 1963 NFL season, computed from Pro Football Archives' facts: every player of its 14 clubs who played a game but the punters and long snappers, as [name, franchise (scripts/data/nfl-teams.json), the site's positions, game position, overall, { id: the site's player page, no: jersey, gp: games, gs: starts, value, played: the position a kicker also played, also: other clubs that season }], written by scripts/sync-pfa.mjs. The overall is ours (conversion): read off Madden NFL 2002, then moved with the player's club (`moves`: each club's SRS in points a game, its target, its strength the match model plays before and after, and its move, every player by `shift` and its best `plus` by one more). `games`: the season's games the SRS reads, [date, home, away, home points, away points, 'N' at a neutral venue].

source.compiler: Pro Football Archives (the facts); the overall ours

conversion.overall: Ours, computed: no game rated this NFL season. Each player's season value (his club's credit, its points per game against the league's to the power 0.25, offence and defence apart, shared out: the offensive line by starts; quarterbacks, backs, receivers and tight ends by production, rushing and receiving yards, 0.2 a passing yard, 40 a touchdown and less 60 an interception thrown, and by starts; defenders two thirds by starts and one third by plays, 2 a sack where recorded, 1.5 an interception, 1 a fumble recovered, 1 a return touchdown; kickers by field goals, extra points and accuracy against the league) is ranked among the league-season's players at his game position (ties by starts, then games played) and read off Madden NFL 2002's overalls at that position (the 2001 season: maddenratings.net's 31 team spreadsheets, punters left out), as many of each Madden team's best as the season carries per club, by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1–99. Then each club moves toward its results: its target is T = μ + √r × S ÷ m, where S is its Simple Rating System (its margins by least squares with a home edge, the NFL's ratings summing to nought) from the season's 98 games, r = 0.768 their reliability, m = 1.948 points of margin a game for each point of the strength the match model plays (its lineup's offence and defence, their mean), measured over 160,000 simulated games under the season's rules, and μ = 78.36 the clubs' mean strength before the move. Every player of a club moves by one whole number and its best few by one more, held to 1–99 and never past a teammate rated above him, whichever brings the club nearest its target: −2 to +4 points this season. The results count twice, by design: the credit's points for and against place a club's players at their positions and weigh its offence against its defence, and the move then sets the club's level from its margins, wherever the credit left it. Facts from Pro Football Archives; the weights tuned once on 2001–2005 against the next season's Madden launch ratings, then frozen.
